why: Poppy Ridge closed for 13 months and reopened 31 May 2025 as an all-new Jay Blasi 18 (plus The Ridge 9). This map is the old 27-hole layout: its hole lines and greens point at ground that no longer exists. Card + rangefinder only until the new course is mapped. The old file is kept at ~/battletees-national/drawn/2305-old-layout-before-holdback.json (9/19).
